title: SAUGE: Taming SAM for Uncertainty-Aligned Multi-Granularity Edge Detection
mechanism: Frozen SAM with a 1.5% adapter that fuses intermediate SAM layers coarse to fine; linearly blended labels give granularity pseudo-labels.
adaptation: Frozen SAM/SAM2 encoder with multi-layer adapter fusion and crack-only head on 1-channel EL replicated to 3, aimed at E1 half-cut cells and scuff confounders.
min_experiment: Arm: SAUGE-style adapter on frozen SAM, 3 seeds; baseline PF. Metric E1 crack relF1@2 and test crack IoU. Kill if E1 relF1@2 below PF single model. About 20 GPU-h.
evidence: R: strong cross-dataset generalisation, SOTA on BSDS500, Multicue, NYUDv2 (abstract).
prior_overlap: Partial: frozen SAM2 Hiera-T linear probe showed no gain, but that was single layer, no adapter, no decoder; adapters listed as open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Frozen SAM or SAM2 encoder with a multi-layer adapter for crack, aimed at E1 (half-cut cells, scuff streaks). Granularity blending maps to label-width styles per source.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: frozen SAM + SAUGE adapter on crack, 3 seeds. Baseline: house and PF. Metric: E1 relF1@2 and crack recall. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gains less than 0.03.
